title: Portfolio journal
description: Desk mock book behind the Vault wall. A 50000 book sizes Spotlight and Featured Options Radar lines to a 4000 ticket. Earnings Snapshot, Weekly Radar Earnings Preview, and Weekly Radar Credit Spread of the Week are one contract. Closed lines carry that line's ticket PnL. Open lines may carry a mark (mtm_*); the page shows a dash and keeps the line Open until the journal has one. No broker mark is pulled by the page.

as_of_ct.description: Journal stamp. The week strip totals the ISO week of this date.

stop_stock.description: Stock stop for the line. Shown on open lines when present.

target_stock.description: Stock target for the line. Shown on open lines when present.

exit_ts_ct.description: Fill stamp. The week strip reads the date at the front.

ticket_usd.description: Display ticket for this line. Spotlight and Featured Options Radar stay at 4000. Earnings Snapshot, Weekly Radar Earnings Preview, and Weekly Radar Credit Spread of the Week are one contract, about round(entry_price * 100). PnL dollars are this ticket, not a brokerage fill.

mtm_price.description: Mark for a line still held, per contract or spread. Optional; leave out or null when not marked.

mtm_pnl_usd.description: Mark PnL in dollars for a line still held. Optional; never folded into the closed total.

mtm_as_of_ct.description: When the mark was taken, Central time, e.g. 2026-10-30 3:00 PM CT. Optional.
